answer_1.quote: Natural language interaction is important for better using GUI agents. It's necessary to mix conversation data during the training stage of GUI agents for better interaction. We introduce the GUIChat dataset, which includes lots of text-rich website screenshots and grounding boxes in dialogues.

answer_2.quote: We use the type exact match score (Type EM), click accuracy (Cli. Acc), and step success rate (StepSR) as metrics. For OCR and grounding tasks we also report EM, F1 and IoU scores.
